snippet.title: Ghostslayers – Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4484980/Ghostslayers_Demo/

Ghostslayers is a top-down magic shooter where you and up to 3 of your friends (locally) clean out different locations from a bunch of remnant monsters, combining the firepower of wacky weapons with chaotic destructive spells that completely fill the rooms with bullets, explosions, turrets, friends, spikeballs and whatever else you can cast.

It has been an absolute blast getting here to release this demo, I am very thankful to all my friends and family for helping me throughout all the way. None of this would have been real without yall. Thank you.
